title: Mind Identity
description: Canonical implementation-independent identity value used by Mind Protocol.

asset_ref.description: Opaque canonical asset identifier. Resolution belongs to the concrete mind implementation, not the universal identity value.

id.description: Stable provider-independent identifier within the identity's declared namespace.

display_name.description: Canonical human-readable name; not a provider handle.

visual_identity.description: Optional semantic visual identity. Asset resolution is deliberately outside this universal contract.
